proposal.summary: Create PostgreSQL reminders table with numeric identity, text and time columns, priority restricted to HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, and MEDIUM default.
proposal.patch:
diff --git a/db/migration/V1__reminders_priority.sql b/db/migration/V1__reminders_priority.sql
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migration/V1__reminders_priority.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+-- P4 / SOL-002: PostgreSQL reminder schema with constrained priority.
+CREATE TABLE public.reminders (
+    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
+    text varchar(140) NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 140),
+    at time(0) without time zone NOT NULL,
+    priority varchar(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEDIUM'
+        CHECK (priority IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW')),
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
